Questions

Frequently asked questions

What is ROBORAB?

ROBORAB implements AI agents into companies' business processes. You can start with free diagnostics in chat, choose a ready-made solution from the catalog, or order a solution for your business.

How do you implement artificial intelligence in business processes?

You describe the task to the AI agent by text, voice or video call. The agent writes a summary of your request, a technical specialist customizes a ready-made solution for you, and the next day the tool is already in the app.

How much does AI implementation cost?

Diagnostics in chat is free. Implementation is priced individually: you can get a cost estimate in the chat within 10 minutes.

Which systems do you work with?

With spreadsheets, databases and 1C. Agents can stay in our app or be deployed on your server. For lawyers we build multi-agent systems that track changes in the law and review cases.

What will I get after the diagnosis?

A list of where you lose money and time, and a specialist proposal: a ready-made product or a solution from scratch.

What if I do not need AI?

We will say so directly. The diagnosis is free, so you risk nothing.

Which ready-made solutions are in the catalog?

Fitness CRM, a tax agent for a group of companies, construction accounting, a booking CRM for hotel requests, and SEO and GEO setup.

Can AI replace an employee or a whole function?

Yes. ROBORAB is built into your company's internal processes and takes over the work of a specific person or area. You save money and time.

Where do I start if I do not know what I need?

Start with the diagnosis: tell the AI agent about your business in the chat. It will help find where processes get stuck. A specialist will review the summary and suggest what to implement.

Can I order something that is not in the catalog?

Yes. We will tailor a ready-made product to you, combine several products (the Hybrid solution) or build a solution entirely around you. We also build websites.

Which languages is the site available in?

The site is available in Russian, English, Chinese and Arabic. You change the language with the globe button in the top-right corner of the first screen.
